messages:
Maya: quick sync — we need 3 distinct social teaser posts + a short benchmark narrative to use in the webinar landing page and follow-up. webinar date: Tue 3/31. core hooks: low-latency + cost-per-token savings + free starter credits for attendees. can someone own copy + routing?

Josh: I can take the copy. want A/B variants per channel (twitter/linkedin) or keep same message shorter vs long?

Maya: A/B for sure — short punchy for X, slightly longer for LinkedIn. also need 1 paragraph benchmark blurb (stats + methodology link) and one line CTA for the demo sign-up.

Sophia: drafting 3 teaser options now. roughs: 
1) "Ship LLM features with predictable latency — see our benchmark vs standard hosting. Free credits for attendees. RSVP."
2) "How we cut inference cost by 3x without accuracy loss — demo + credits. Join 3/31."
3) "Benchmarks, prompts, and a starter pack — live walkthrough + credits for devs."
Which tone do we prefer? technical or product-first?

Josh: I prefer 1 & 2 for X and LinkedIn respectively. tech team can signpost numbers in carousel tweet thread.

Jordan: for the benchmark blurb: keep claim tight. we can say "median latency X ms at Y throughput; ~3x cost reduction vs baseline config (see appendix)" — Rahul can drop the exact numbers and the public doc link. avoid absolute claims like "10x" unless benched.

Rahul: link: https://go.redwood/bench/mar-launch (internal). measured on g4dn‑like seed hardware, seq len 256, concurrent streams 12. median p50 latency 42ms, p95 210ms, cost per 1k tokens ~ $0.37 vs baseline $1.1. will add short methodology paragraph for the landing.

Maya: perfect. ops: we need inbound routing rules for attendees who sign up via the landing. plan: 
- utm params: utm_source=webinar&utm_campaign=mar-launch&utm_content=teaserA
- tag lead as "webinar-mar-31"
- credit gating: attendee email -> 100 starter credits; if company domain in enterprise allowlist then 500 credits and handoff to AE.
Can Lee set that up?

Lee (ops): noted. I'll add the UTM-based funnel rule to Growth CRM + create promo code "MAR31-STARTER" for automated credit issuance. confirm the allowlist file and AE handoff webhook details, please.

Maya: allowlist is in the shared drive: /marketing/allowlist_mar.json. AE webhook: /hooks/ae-hand-off-prod.

Sophia: shareable copy for follow-up email (short): 
"Thanks for joining — demo recording + benchmark summary inside. Redeem 100 starter credits: [promo link]. Need help getting started? Try our prompt templates for quick wins."

Josh: can we include a prompt template mini-pack as part of the starter experience? e.g., 3 ready-to-run prompts (summarize, classification, FAQ bot) that auto-sync into the customer's workspace when they redeem credits. Jordan can confirm infra work.

Jordan: yes — product can expose an onboarding endpoint to inject prompt templates. need spec: template IDs and a scope flag. I'll prioritize after the landing goes live.

Maya: deadlines — copy + benchmarks finalized by EOD Fri (3123456810). Ops routing + promo code by Mon EOD (3123456820). Sophia/visuals: creative assets by Mon noon. Josh: headline + variants for X/linkedin by Thu.

Calendar Bot: Event created: "Mar 31 — Launch Webinar: Serving Benchmarks + Starter Credits" — invite sent to #marketing and product.

Rahul: adding the methodology blurb to the doc now. will ping when link is public.

Josh: thumbs up — I'll drop initial copy into the Google doc: https://docs.google.com/xxx and tag people.

Maya: thanks team! short checklist in the doc so we can track. :rocket:
